_note: Metadata prepared for a future x402 Bazaar listing of this gateway. NOT submitted anywhere and the gateway is NOT deployed (ops/BRIEF.md S3 scope: 'デプロイと掲載はしない'). Each route already carries this same discovery info live (see gateway/src/server.ts, declareDiscoveryExtension calls) — this file is a human-readable, submission-ready copy of the same facts, for the future listing step.
description: Bundles three permissively-licensed free public data sources (USGS earthquakes, NOAA/NWS weather, World Bank indicators) behind pay-per-call x402 HTTP endpoints, so an agent can fetch any of them with a single micropayment instead of registering for three separate free-tier accounts.
networkNote: Base Sepolia testnet by default (FACILITATOR_NETWORK env var). Switch to eip155:8453 (Base mainnet) only once EVM_PAYTO_ADDRESS is a real, owned wallet.
payToStatus: TEST MODE placeholder (0x000000000000000000000000000000000000dEaD) until EVM_PAYTO_ADDRESS is set to a real wallet

resources.description: USGS earthquake feed passthrough (public domain, US govt data).
NOAA/NWS forecast passthrough for a lat/lon point (public domain, US govt data, US locations only).

upstreamSource.name: NOAA National Weather Service API
upstreamSource.license: US Public Domain (with non-endorsement / non-misrepresentation conditions)
upstreamSource.technicalNote: api.weather.gov expects an identifying User-Agent header; this is handled server-side, not by the caller.

resources.description: World Bank open data indicator passthrough (CC BY 4.0, attribution: World Bank).

upstreamSource.name: World Bank Open Data API
upstreamSource.attributionImplementation: Every response includes meta.source='World Bank' and meta.license='CC BY 4.0'; data is republished verbatim (no modification), per license condition to flag any changes.

indicator.description: World Bank indicator code, e.g. NY.GDP.MKTP.CD

excludedCandidateSources.name: CoinGecko free API
excludedCandidateSources.reason: Free-tier terms restrict redistribution/resale of the data; excluded.

excludedCandidateSources.name: OpenStreetMap / Nominatim
excludedCandidateSources.reason: ODbL share-alike plus a usage policy that discourages heavy scripted/production use; poor fit for an always-on paid resale gateway. Not included in this build.

excludedCandidateSources.name: Japan e-Stat (政府統計の総合窓口)
excludedCandidateSources.reason: 政府標準利用規約2.0 permits commercial reuse, but requires a free `appId` registration, which would break the zero-setup local demo. Good v2 candidate, not included now.

deploymentStatus: NOT deployed. Runs locally only via `npm run gateway` (see ops/S2S3/STATUS.md). This file exists so that if/when the user approves deployment + listing, the submission step is a copy-paste rather than a research step.
